subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu accept bot-authored group messages by default when the include-bot scope is granted, or require operators to opt in with allowBots before bot-to-bot dispatch can happen?
rationale: This is a user-visible channel policy and upgrade-default choice: preserving current admission avoids breaking any existing Feishu bot-to-bot setups, while a restrictive default better matches some sibling-channel safety posture.

options.title: Preserve Default Accept
options.body: Keep omitted allowBots accepting Feishu bot-authored messages, relying on self-filtering and loop protection as the upgrade guard.

options.title: Default To Mentions Only
options.body: Change omitted allowBots to behave like "mentions" so unmentioned bot traffic is ignored unless operators choose a broader mode.

options.title: Require Explicit Opt-In
options.body: Make omitted allowBots ignore bot-authored messages and require true or "mentions" for bot-to-bot conversations.

recommendation.title: Preserve Default Accept
recommendation.body: Keep omitted allowBots accepting Feishu bot-authored messages, relying on self-filtering and loop protection as the upgrade guard.

likelyOwner.reason: Sliverp is the documented Chinese-channel owner signal for Feishu, and this decision is channel policy rather than a generic core runtime repair.
